description: Builds a robots.txt file that explicitly allows or blocks named AI crawlers from Citehound’s tracked list of 10, plus an optional Sitemap line. Pure text generation — fetches nothing. Call list_ai_crawlers first if you need the exact tracked crawler names.

allow.description: Crawler names to explicitly allow, e.g. ["GPTBot", "ClaudeBot"]. Must be names from the tracked list.

block.description: Crawler names to explicitly block. Must be names from the tracked list, and must not overlap with "allow".

sitemap_url.description: Optional absolute sitemap URL to add as a Sitemap: line, e.g. "https://example.com/sitemap.xml".

name: generate_robots_txt
title: Generate an AI-crawler robots.txt
